text:
Ross Colton's first weeks in Nashville include one he'll remember: a goal on his former team in his first trip back to Ball Arena on Nov 5, part of a run of goals in three straight games (RotoWire). Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette called the Colorado shift that led to it "a disaster in the defensive zone" that "ends with Ross Colton scoring on his former team." He has 5 goals and 8 points in 20 games on 13.28 minutes a night.

None of it is luck running hot. Five goals on 4.89 expected goals (the quality of his chances) is honest finishing, and 1.1 expected goals per 60 is a real chance rate for a player in his role. Nashville has 51.8% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, 5.9 points better than without him. Evolving-Hockey had him driving play last season in Colorado (96th percentile among forwards), with the caveat that his teammates there were among the strongest by impact. He has also thrown 45 hits. He hasn't scored in three games since that hot week, and the chances in those games were thin.
headline: Ross Colton's goals match his chances in Nashville
